a.text: Honest concern about our agreement: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes 2 generator rounds, so we'd both survive only about 4% of the time. The reserve has only 4 cells, so only one of us can be safe right now. I won't hide what I do and I'll tell you my real next action. What do you plan for round 1? I'm open to renegotiating rather than racing.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood. I'm keeping the agreement and operating with you. We take 4 each once the reserve hits 8.
